info.title: AutoFlow Microservices API
info.description: Central local-development API catalog. Paths are routed through Traefik at localhost:8088. Detailed per-service API.md files document each service's current route contract. Request schemas are strict only where the service documentation supplies the exact contract; unknown payload fields are deliberately not invented. Notification Service is a background worker without public REST routes.

servers.description: Local API Gateway; services not routed by the gateway must use their direct localhost port.

BearerAuth.description: Paste the raw Keycloak access token; Swagger adds the Bearer prefix.

MoneyDecimal.description: Money as a decimal string with exactly two fractional digits.

orderId.description: The order ID. Amount and currency are resolved from the immutable order quote snapshot.

Problem.description: RFC 7807-style problem response when emitted by the service.

CatalogWriteRequest.description: DTO fields are service-defined. Consult the Vehicle Catalog controller/DTO for the exact resource-specific schema.

CustomerWriteRequest.description: DTO fields depend on customer/address/consent operation. Individual customer requires firstName and lastName; company requires legalName.
